name: Paris
notes:
LitArbi 0.9.38-beta “Paris” (build 38): the add-ins follow every numbering.
• The Word macro and the LibreOffice Writer add-in now know every numbering of a matter, not just the one open in LitArbi. A Statement of Claim open in Word or Writer is cited and renumbered in the Statement's own numbers: numbers taken over from the Notice and the other side's (R-5) are kept, and new exhibits follow on after them.
• LibreOffice Writer: Windows now uses the same add-in as the Mac. A submission cited in Writer can be updated on either platform. Update no longer adds a second List of Exhibits.
• Names with accents and umlauts (Müller, Çap) are read correctly by the Word macro and the Writer add-in.
• Shared matters: numbers used twice after a sync are now found in every numbering and named with it, e.g. “C-3 (Notice of Dispute)”.
• Build 37: backups of your matters (Settings → Backup), and Recently Deleted / History on the Server.
